Primary Care Progress Note
Date: 07/13/2026
Patient: Samara Runolfsdottir, 79 y/o F

CC: Back pain

HPI: Back pain since 07/08/2026 after lifting a laundry basket. No radiculopathy or numbness reported. No bowel/bladder dysfunction.

PE: Tenderness over lumbar paraspinals. No step-offs or deformities noted. Neuro exam intact.

Assessment: Acute mechanical back pain likely muscular strain.

Plan: Conservative mgmt with NSAIDs, rest, and gradual return to activity. Follow-up prn.

notes.title: Radiology Report
notes.author: Radiologist
notes.text:
Radiology Report
Date: 08/29/2026
Patient: Samara Runolfsdottir, 79 y/o F

MRI 08/29/2026: T12 compression fx, marrow edema on STIR.

No other acute fractures identified. No paraspinal soft tissue mass or abnormal enhancement. Disc spaces preserved without significant bulge or herniation. No cord signal abnormality or compression noted.

Impression: T12 compression fracture with marrow edema consistent with acute/subacute injury. No additional acute osseous abnormalities.

notes.title: Spine Intervention Consultation
notes.author: Interventional radiologist
notes.text:
Spine Intervention Consultation
Date: 09/01/2026
Patient: Samara Runolfsdottir, 79 y/o F

Outpt, not admitted. Pt c/o persistent back pain. NRS 7/10 despite 7 wks NSM (acetaminophen and calcitonin nasal spray, TLSO brace). Pain worse x2 wks despite brace. Exam: tenderness over lumbar spine, no neuro deficits.

Imaging reviewed: lumbar spinal stenosis evident. Back pain is primarily from lumbar spinal stenosis rather than the fracture. Referred for DEXA + osteoporosis program.

Plan: Consider interventional options targeting stenosis. Continue current meds and brace. Monitor response.
